page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-96-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It is configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 360.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per virtual core. This configuration does not include any GPU accelerators, and local storage is not configured.

The instance features dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants. With a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of nearly 1:4, the hardware profile supports multi-threaded workloads that require substantial processing power alongside a proportional memory footprint. The lack of public IPv4 addresses by default requires external networking configurations for public internet access.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory density offer a predictable performance-to-resource profile for high-density virtualization and enterprise deployments, avoiding the overhead of specialized storage or GPU hardware. This server type is appropriate for general-purpose enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, and multi-threaded processing tasks.
